result.method: Batched JSON-RPC reads pinned to the block hash (EIP-1898); EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / beacon proxies; capabilities from PUSH4 selectors in proxy + implementation bytecode (heuristic).
result.summary: Competing admin / role-authority surfaces were detected (multisig_safe 0xC9dA980fFABbE2bbe15d4734FDae5761B86b5Fc3 via eip1967_admin_slot; grantRole / setAuthority in the bytecode (PUSH4 heuristic)) and are not resolved to a single delayed controller: inspect every owner, admin and role holder before relying on it. Capabilities seen in bytecode: upgrade.

assessment.method: Live bytecode + storage heuristic at the pinned block only: this contract is not in Pacta's indexed catalog (no documentation comparison).
limits: riskScore (0-100) is a heuristic of the controller type and of pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities read at one block; it is not an audit.

The live check reads EIP-1967 slots, owner(), Safe getThreshold() / getOwners() and TimelockController getMinDelay(); custom role systems, bridge or L2 admin paths and off-chain operations are not resolved.
Documentation is compared only for indexed protocols (catalogMatch), at their pinned block.

result.coverage_gap_hint: Target is not yet indexed or fully classified. Ask the user if they want you to queue coverage or request this capability via pacta_submit_request (free community queue, or 24h priority clearance for issuers).

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.

endpoints.unlocks: fast contract / token control-plane verdict: riskScore 0-100, grade A-F, upgrade / owner / pause / blacklist / mint flags and a shareable scan URL
full control-plane dossier: every controller Safe's signers and threshold, signers shared with other indexed protocols, Base EAS proof
pre-signing calldata check: timelock / Safe / multicall calls decoded, each rated against live delays and the authority that governs it
deep control-plane scan cross-checked on two independent RPC operators, auditor receipt and a queued Base EAS ticket

pinnedDualRpcChainProof.note: Mismatch summary: Bedrock Security docs claim Chainlink Proof of Reserve / Secure Mint verifies reserve sufficiency before any minting action and reverts if reserves fall short of total uniBTC supply (100% reserve backing, https://docs.bedrock.technology/security/secure-mint). On-chain at finalized Ethereum block #26448763, VaultWithoutNative (0x047D41F2544B7F63A8e991aF2068a363d210d6Da, impl 01e9161d1621466eb086651fd514d3efb8c3752e) sets adequacyRatio() = 900. With adequacyRatio() = 900, checkReserve() compares 90% of the feeder-reported existing supply against reserves before minting. Ignoring integer rounding, its precondition admits existing supply up to approximately 111.1% of reported reserves, and omits the incoming mint amount so 111.1% is not a post-mint supply ceiling (separate per-asset caps and collateral-transfer requirements in _mint() still apply, and uniBTC.mint() performs no PoR check). MANAGER_ROLE (setAdequacyRatio / setPoRFeeder) is held by an externally controlled account (0x9251fd3D79522bB2243a58FFf1dB43E25A495aaB, carrying 23-byte EIP-7702 delegation code rather than empty bytecode, while remaining an EOA holding MANAGER_ROLE / PAUSER_ROLE) with 0s timelock; both Vault (0x047D41F2544B7F63A8e991aF2068a363d210d6Da) and uniBTC (0x004E9C3EF86bc1ca1f0bB5C7662861Ee93350568) share ProxyAdmin (0x029E4FbDAa31DE075dD74B2238222A08233978f6) owned by a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe (0xC9dA980fFABbE2bbe15d4734FDae5761B86b5Fc3) with 0s upgrade timelock; and uniBTC's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the same 3-of-5 Safe while MINTER_ROLE is held by external contracts (including 0x70Af4743f85e5E74E3B6DDfA38926C0A762ad21c).

docsQuote: Before any minting action occurs, the smart contract automatically checks reserve sufficiency using the on-chain Proof of Reserve feed. If reserves fall short, the mint transaction reverts.
